summary: Approves a 10-year lease for Metro to use 74,374 square feet of office space at 1283 Murfreesboro Pike, owned by Hessel Properties, GP. Rent is $1,601,272.22 in the first year and goes up about 3% each year to $2,089,165.66 in year 10, and Metro gets a $1,200,000 allowance for interior improvements.
